technical_and_design_decisions: Use Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
Leverage existing Spring XD module framework for implementing new source, sink, and processor modules.
For Kafka source offset control, persist offsets in a state store (e.g., Redis or file-based) to survive crashes.
Partition pre-allocation will use a deterministic hash-based assignment based on module instance IDs and partition count.
Reactor-stream processor module will use Project Reactor (Spring's reactive library) for time-window operations.
Microbatching capability will be implemented as a generic buffering wrapper around existing source modules, with a configurable batch interval.
Performance testing infrastructure will be set up on Rackspace using existing cloud provisioning scripts and tools.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD codebase is available and stable, and we are adding new features to it.
The developer is proficient in Java, Spring Framework, Kafka, and related technologies.
All user stories are independent and can be developed in parallel, but we assume sequential development by a single developer.
Testing includes unit and integration tests for each feature; test environment is available locally.
Documentation (U1) will be written after feature implementation to ensure accuracy.
Spark investigation (U5) includes literature review, setting up a small Spark cluster, and producing a design document.
Performance testing infrastructure setup (U8) includes provisioning Rackspace instances, installing Kafka, and configuring monitoring tools.
No significant external dependencies or delays (e.g., approval cycles, hardware procurement) are expected.

activities.activity_name: Documentation for new modules and features
activities.activity_description: Write Wiki documentation covering configuration of new sources, sinks, processor modules, and any new features (e.g., offset control, pre-allocation, microbatching). Includes review and updates based on implementation.

Implement feature to allow users to specify starting offset for Kafka source when deploying a stream. Ensure progress survives crashes, and redeployment with a specific offset causes reread. Modifications to stream deployment logic, Kafka source module, and state persistence.

activities.activity_name: Partition pre-allocation for Kafka source modules
activities.activity_description: Implement pre-allocation of partitions between Kafka source modules on stream deployment to avoid rebalancing. Develop assignment algorithm and integrate with deployment and module lifecycle.

activities.activity_name: Message bus partition pre-allocation between nodes
activities.activity_description: Implement pre-allocation of partitions for the Spring XD message bus to prevent rebalancing on container crash or redeployment. Similar to A3 but for internal bus; share design patterns.
Research Spark streaming integration, develop a proof-of-concept, and produce a design document for best approach to integrate with XD. Includes setting up a small Spark test environment.

Implement a processor module using reactor-stream for time-window operations (e.g., min, avg over configurable time window). Handle configuration parsing, window logic, and integration with XD module framework.
Add batchInterval option to source modules (e.g., http) to buffer data and flush at specified intervals for improved throughput. Implement buffering and integration with existing source pipelines.

Set up Rackspace cloud environment for benchmarking: provision instances, install Kafka and dependencies, configure monitoring and test harness. Does not include running benchmarks or analyzing results.
Integrate all implemented features into a cohesive release, perform end-to-end testing across user stories, fix integration issues, and ensure documentation alignment.
